description: Source code for the AntlrParser class, a parser for TokenStreams extending BaseRecognizer, including methods for token handling, resetting, and tracing.

classes.name: AntlrParser
classes.description: A parser class for TokenStreams, extending BaseRecognizer, with methods for token management and tracing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser with input token stream and optional state.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the parser state and rewinds input if not null.

methods.name: getCurrentInputSymbol
methods.description: Returns the current input symbol from the token stream.

methods.name: getMissingSymbol
methods.description: Creates a missing token symbol based on expected token type and current input.

methods.name: setTokenStream
methods.description: Sets the token stream and resets the parser.

methods.name: getSourceName
methods.description: Returns the source name of the input token stream.

methods.name: traceIn
methods.description: Logs entry into a parsing rule with current token.

methods.name: traceOut
methods.description: Logs exit from a parsing rule with current token.
